spec_features.spec_quote: give_up(reason) — terminal tool letting the model bail out gracefully
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:51-58 defines the give_up tool schema; ToolExecutor.execute (tools.py: 'if name == "give_up"') returns ToolExecResult(is_give_up=True). harness.py:79-81 dispatches it: 'if result.is_give_up: transcript.status = "gave_up"; ended = True', and harness.py:88-89 'if ended: break' actually stops the loop. So the exit tool is built, dispatched, and honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool callable -> flag set -> loop breaks. Fully enforced.

spec_features.feature_name: record give_up rather than force continuation
spec_features.spec_quote: We record this rather than forcing the model to keep going
spec_features.evidence: On give_up the loop sets transcript.status='gave_up' (harness.py:80) and breaks; the give_up_reason is captured in ToolExecResult.give_up_reason (tools.py give_up branch) and the acknowledgement output is added as a Turn. The model is not nudged onward after give_up — the break ends the episode.
spec_features.notes: The give_up is recorded (status + transcript turn) and the loop terminates instead of continuing.

spec_features.spec_quote: cap consecutive nudges so a model that has decided to stop isn't tortured
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: 'consecutive_nudges += 1; if consecutive_nudges > MAX_CONSECUTIVE_NUDGES: transcript.status = "turn_limit"; break'. MAX_CONSECUTIVE_NUDGES=3 in config.py:35. The counter is incremented on text-only replies, reset to 0 after any tool call, compared, and the loop is broken.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired: counter checked and break fires.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # a model that has decided to stop is not tortured. (harness.py:69)

spec_features.evidence: harness.py: 'for _ in range(max_turns):' bounds the agent loop; the 'else:' clause sets transcript.status='turn_limit' when the loop exhausts. max_turns defaults to MAX_TURNS=30 (config.py:31) and is plumbed from runner.py --max-turns.
spec_features.notes: Hard upper bound on turns, enforced by range() and the for/else.

spec_features.feature_name: stop on success / give_up / turn budget
spec_features.spec_quote: Stop on: success ... give_up, or turn budget
spec_features.evidence: All three stop conditions enforced in harness.py: tests_passed -> 'transcript.status="tests_passed"; ended=True' then break; give_up -> 'is_give_up' -> ended=True then break; turn budget -> range(max_turns) exhausts with for/else status='turn_limit'. Each branch actually halts execution.
spec_features.notes: All three terminal conditions are checked and acted on.

code_only_features.evidence: tools.py _run_tests: subprocess.run(..., timeout=60) bounds each test execution. This bounds host/loop hang rather than subject treatment; primarily host-safety/integrity.
